title: I'm paying for your tokens! My multiplayer game jam is LIVE now and winner takes $1000 ($2000 prize pool)
author: onedayiwaswalkingand
selftext:
Hey all! My first game jam is now OFFICIALLY LIVE! I've already seen quite a few joining from the warm up post so it seem people liked it! Here's a why you should take a look:

* Everything is **FREE**. Token cost is on me! (Plus it's GPT-5.5) (Please don't bankrupt me)
* And I've put in cool tools like 3D modeling and rigging! 
* Every game is multiplayer and you will get a lot of real users for your game!
* SerpAPI is baked in, so your games can pull live data at runtime!
* You get a chance to win the big prize!

The prize pool set up:

* 💰 $2,000 prize pool 🥇 
   * 1st — $1,000 + featured in-app 
   * 🥈 2nd — $500 + featured 
   * 🥉 3rd — $200 + featured 
   * 🏅 4th–6th — $100 each

**Runs through June 8 · voting closes June 15.** 

**Would love to see what you make.** 

 🔗 [https://itch.io/jam/partytime-game-jam-1](https://itch.io/jam/partytime-game-jam-1)
